statement: let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); ∀ (M N : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℂ) (a δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → let S (t : ℝ) := ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico M (M + N), c k * E ((k : ℝ) * t); ‖S a‖ ^ 2 ≤ (intervalIntegral (fun t => ‖S t‖ ^ 2) (a-δ) (a+δ) MeasureTheory.volume) / (2 * δ) + intervalIntegral (fun t => ‖S t‖ * ‖deriv S t‖) (a-δ) (a+δ) MeasureTheory.volume

plain_statement.en: At the midpoint of a window of radius δ, the squared norm of a trigonometric sum is bounded by its mean squared norm plus the integral of |S| |S′| on that window.
plain_statement.zh: 在半径为 δ 的窗口中点，三角和的模平方不超过窗口上的模平方均值加上 |S| |S′| 的积分。

brief.en: Integrate the variation estimate on each half of the window. Each half has length δ, giving coefficient one for the derivative term after averaging.
brief.zh: 在窗口左右两半分别积分变差估计。每半段长度均为 δ，取平均后导数项的系数为 1。
